author: TEDx Talks
description:
In her talk, Megan challenges the way companies think about social media by showing how it has quietly become the place where trust, connection, and reputation are formed long before a customer ever interacts with a brand. She argues that social media is no longer just a marketing tool, but a core part of business strategy, and that today’s companies need a new seat in the C-suite to keep up with cultural shifts in the creator economy. By reframing social media as relationship-building rather than promotion, she reveals how connection and community can naturally drive conversion in a digital world.

Megan is a social media strategist and social media agency owner with nine years of experience helping businesses grow organically through community, referrals, and authentic storytelling. title: Why social media deserves a seat in the c-suite | Megan Shallow | TEDxWest Vancouver

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this talk, Dr. Kaydian Reid examines the American Dream through the lens of both personal storytelling and academic insight. She unpacks the often-overlooked costs of pursuing this ideal, questioning its attainability and exploring how striving for the American Dream shapes the lives, wellbeing, and opportunities of those who chase it. Dr. Kaydian Simone Reid is an Associate Professor and Director of Public Health Programs at the University of Saint Joseph, where her research, teaching, and practice focus on health equity. As a mixed-methods researcher, she explores how ethnic identity affects the health of English-speaking Afro- Caribbean immigrants, examining its role in shaping health practices and outcomes across generations. Her academic work is rooted in real-world public health experience
and personal insight as an Afro- Caribbean immigrant woman. Being both an immigrant and a mother, Dr. Reid brings personal and professional dedication to her field. Her notable achievements
title: The overlooked costs of the American Dream | Dr. Kaydian Simone Reid | TEDxProspect Hill

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this talk, Caty Poole explores how we can reimagine local food systems and centers real stories from community members who struggle to afford and access food. She offers a vision for a food system rooted in sustainability and abundance, one that is people-powered, community-forward, and designed to truly meet human needs. As the innovator behind Caty’s Creations, Caty brings three decades of life sciences experience and a communications degree to her career in food and farming. Her journey began with a passion for equitable food access, which led her to Massaro Community Farm in Woodbridge, CT in 2012. During her 11-year tenure as executive director, she deepened her expertise—from backyard gardening to nutrition, beekeeping, and wild crafting—while establishing farm- based educational programs rooted in her family’s agricultural heritage. She has expanded her knowledge through courses in vegan cooking, herbalism, and wild
foraging, earning a Master’s certificate from The Institute
title: What if we could eliminate food insecurity in CT? | Caty Poole | TEDxProspect Hill

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this talk, Fereshteh Ganjavi shares a powerful story about igniting passion, education, and hope in the lives of others. She explores why access to learning is a fundamental human right—and how education can move individuals from mere survival toward a deeper sense of power, belonging, and connection. Fereshteh Ganjavi is the Founder and Executive Director of Elena’s Light, a New Haven–based nonprofit empowering refugee and immigrant women through education, leadership, and advocacy. A former refugee from Afghanistan, she has transformed her journey of resilience into a model of community empowerment—building partnerships with over 120 universities nationwide to connect emerging leaders with programs that help hundreds of women gain independence through English learning, health education, and access to essential resources. Fereshteh serves as a Board Advisor for PCORI (Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Institute), a TEDxNewHaven Organizer, and a Vital Voices Fellow and two-time Wo
title: How education can move refugees from surviving to belonging | Fereshteh Ganjavi | TEDxProspect Hill

author: TEDx Talks
description:
This talk challenges the idea that comfort equals safety, arguing that it can quietly limit growth and potential. It explores how real progress begins when we act despite fear and choose discomfort over stagnation. Ultimately, it reminds us that the greatest risk is not failure — but never trying at all. He is a high school student—an ordinary young man with big aspirations, ready to work hard in pursuit of success.
He is deeply interested in learning and mastering modern skills and professions such as programming, video editing, and design. Quiet yet highly motivated, he consistently strives to reach his full potential and become his ideal version of himself. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Comfort: A Dangerous Addiction  | Salokhiddin Khazratkulov | TEDxVosiq International School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
彼时的兴隆咖啡，虽有侨乡文化底蕴，却面临产业链零散、品牌影响力弱、咖农种植积极性下滑的困境。行业内普遍认为，“传统区域咖啡很难在全国市场立足”。跨界进入完全陌生的咖啡赛道，确实是一场“冒险”，但自贸港政策中预见了机遇：“海南的政策红利+兴隆咖啡的文化基底，只要用标准化、全产业链的思维深耕，就能让老品牌走出新路子。”
作为新上任的兴隆咖啡行业协会会长，他积极组织兴隆咖啡传统非遗焙炒工艺培训班、咖啡产业高素质农民培训班与咖啡职业培训班，推动行业整体提升。他将正大在农牧产业的标准化管理经验搬到咖啡赛道，升级生产线保留非遗炭烧工艺的同时引入新工艺，更巧用“零关税”政策实现“全球采购、海南加工”的模式创新。
自2025年担任正大（海南）兴隆咖啡产业开发有限公司总经理以来，他带领团队迅速推出多款创新咖啡产品，斩获国际咖啡品鉴大赛金奖，并将生产园区升级为年接待40万人次的AAA级旅游景区，实现营收同比增长近20%。2025年下半年，兴隆咖啡接连实现关键突破：10月，隆伯斯塔北京首店开业，完成品牌出岛的“零的突破”；11月，成功落地海南自贸港咖啡类目“零关税”政策首单，产品已成功出口至澳大利亚；至12月18日全岛封关当日，公司首批加工增值免关税咖啡豆即顺利通关，标志着“全球采购、海南加工”的创新模式全面跑通，使兴隆咖啡成为海南自贸港产业升级的鲜活标杆。他将分享：如何将现代农牧领域的产业化经验，精准迁移至传统咖啡领域，借势海南自贸港“零关税”政策，打造“全球采购、海南智造”模式，在一年内实现诸多自贸港“零”的关键突破，并从中洞见——真正的跨界，是在政策与文化的交汇处，为传统产业重建全新的增长坐标。 彼时的兴隆咖啡，虽有侨乡文化底蕴，却面临产业链零散、品牌影响力弱、咖农种植积极性下滑的困境。行业内普遍认为，“传统区域咖啡很难在全国市场立足”。跨界进入完全陌生的咖啡赛道，确实是一场“冒险”，但自贸港政策中预见了机遇：“海南的政策红利+兴隆咖啡的文化基底，只要用标准化、全产业链的思维深耕，就能让老品牌走出新路子。”

title: 跨界破局：从农牧到咖啡，预见一杯咖啡的产业力量 | 叶 剑 | TEDxDuhai Road

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this powerful visual experience, Faith Escobedo, combines speed painting and storytelling to reveal an unexpected metaphor for resilience. Faith explores how art communicates what words often cannot, offering comfort, connection, and healing to both the artist and the audience. Faith Escobedo is an artist, speed painter, speaker, and minister with Rick Alonzo Ministries (RAM) where she is certified to carry forward the ministry's mission of sharing the hope and freedom found in Christ. She holds a B.A. in Psychology from California State University, Fresno, and has served in ministry for over a decade, working with children, teens and adults. Today she travels nationally and internationally, partnering with churches, schools, and organizations. Faith also serves in recovery and counseling ministries, helping individuals discover their value and purpose. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more a
title: The Power of Art | Faith Escobedo | TEDxVisalia

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Is gold just a tradition in India, or is it shaping the future of a developed nation? In Role of Gold in Developed India, this talk explores how gold is evolving from a cultural asset into a structured financial instrument that supports economic growth, stability, and innovation. Discover how the metal we inherit may become the foundation of a more financially empowered India. Mr Mahendra Luniya works in the field of digital gold and financial systems, with long term experience in the Indian gold ecosystem. His work focuses on understanding how gold is stored, traded, and integrated into modern financial practices, particularly through digital and structured formats.

Over the years, he has been involved in initiatives related to gold deposits, digital gold mechanisms, and alternative ways of engaging with gold as an asset. His interest lies in exploring how traditional forms of wealth can interact with evolving financial technologies and regulatory frameworks.

title: Role of Gold in Developed India | Mahendra Luniya | TEDxThaltej Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the only thing standing between you and your passion is the belief that it's too late? 

In this talk, David "Davey" Hickman challenges the idea that dreams have deadlines. Drawing from nearly four decades in radio and a lifetime of reinvention, he shares why purpose doesn't expire and how rediscovering what you love can happen at any age. David Hickman (Davey) is a seasoned American radio Dj and beloved on-air personality with a remarkable 38-year career in broadcasting. Originally from New Orleans, Louisiana, Davey has dedicated his life to connecting people through music, storytelling, and service. He has brought his unique voice and passion for community to major markets including Sacramento, Phoenix, Las Vegas, and Fresno; building deep local roots while influencing listeners across generation. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: No expiration date: Turning your passion into purpose | David Hickman | TEDxVisalia

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Now – more than ever, it’s critical to our democracy that we find a way to connect with people to discuss controversial topics. Sharing stories is a very effective way to do that – and everyone has stories to share. Research proves that when we share stories with each other, we connect on a physiological level.  If we truly want to change this dynamic of polarization and division, sharing our personal stories MUST happen with the intention to CONNECT with people - to build trust, NOT to be persuasive – NOT with the intention to change a person’s mind.

Our personal stories have the potential to swing the pendulum from divided to united, one relationship at a time.  Born in Washington, D.C., Sarah grew up in Colorado Springs and received her bachelor’s degree in business from Colorado State University before returning to Washington for a paid internship at the U.S. International Trade Commission.

Nearly 20 years working in federal, state, and local public sector agencies inspired her
title: The power of your personal story | Sarah Elkins | TEDxUStreetWomen

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What does it take to learn when the odds are stacked against you?

For Haroon Azizi, a computer science student in Afghanistan, learning has never been easy. With internet shutdowns, filtered apps, and limited access to schools—especially for girls and women—education often feels impossible. Determined to change this, Haroon founded Hadaf and Code.af, creating platforms that teach programming, design, language, and culture to Afghans everywhere. By combining technology with education, he provides real-world skills, projects, and internships, empowering students to break barriers. This talk shows how innovation, courage, and persistence can make learning possible, even in the toughest circumstances.

 Haroon Azizi is a passionate software engineer, tech enthusiast, and innovator dedicated to transforming the way we learn. As the founder of code.af and Hadaf, an online learning platform, he leverages technology to create accessible, impactful educational experiences. Currently pursuing
title: Learning in the Impossible | Haroon Azizi | TEDxDarulaman

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Qué prótesis existen para el espíritu cuando las circunstancias juegan en nuestra contra?

A menudo cargamos barreras mentales que limitan nuestros propósitos, sueños y acciones; se manifiestan en victimismo, resentimiento y aislamiento.

A partir de un accidente, Valeria inicia una vida nueva y renovada, en la que encuentra sentido en aquello que solemos pasar por alto. En su testimonio, comparte las actitudes que fortalecen nuestro interior: la gratitud, la esperanza y la presencia.

Sin duda, se trata de una masterclass de superación personal y manejo emocional. En diciembre de 2024, un accidente automovilístico en La Paz cambió por completo la vida de Valeria de la Torre al causar la amputación de ambas piernas. Pero en vez de rendirse, convirtió su proceso de rehabilitación en una fuente de inspiración para miles. Hoy, a través de sus redes sociales, comparte su camino hacia la adaptación entre hacer ejercicio, salir y viajar con el uso de prótesis, así como la reconstrucción em
title: No hay prótesis para un espíritu amputado | Val de la Torre | TEDxUniversidadPanamericanaGuadalajara

author: TEDx Talks
description:
After 20 years in public education, Dr. Rachel Edoho-Eket challenges the traditional, high-pressure, and often soul-crushing norms of school leadership. "A Joyful Rebellion" argues that in a system plagued by burnout, "learning loss" narratives, and urgent compliance, joy is not a luxury, it is a necessary act of resistance. Dr. Rachel Edoho-Eket is a wife, mother, principal, author, speaker, and the 2025 President of the Maryland Association of Elementary School Principals. With decades as a teacher and leader in public education, she has earned the reputation as a strong instructional leader, passionate educational advocate, and dedicated mentor. As the Principal of a National Blue Ribbon school in Maryland, she is a life-long learner who strives for excellence not only for herself, but also for everyone she serves. She also serves as an adjunct professor at McDaniel College helping to support the personal and professional growth of aspiring and current school leaders. 

Named as on
title: A new blueprint for leading schools | Dr. Rachel Edoho-Eket | TEDxReisterstown

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Qué pasa cuando el guión que escribiste para tu vida se queda atascado en la misma página por años? 

En esta conmovedora charla, Diego nos invita a cuestionar la rigidez de nuestros planes. A través de una historia personal marcada por la incertidumbre y un giro inesperado nacido de una simple galleta, nos muestra que las mejores escenas de nuestra vida no se fuerzan: se reciben. Si sientes que tu vida no va según lo planeado, este mensaje es para ti. 

Es momento de dejar de pelear con el "Director" y descubrir que la verdadera película empieza cuando te atreves a rendirte. Diego Ibarra, experto en planeación y prevención, descubrió que su mayor desafío no era calcular riesgos, sino aceptar que no tenía el control absoluto de su destino. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: No lo planeamos, y así fue perfecto | Diego Ibarra | TEDxUniversidadPanamericanaGuadalajara
